content.text:
Shift4 (FOUR) **missed** its Q3 2024 end-to-end payment volume guidance by **about 7.4%** at the midpoint.

| | End-to-end payment volume |
|---|---|
| Q3 2024 guidance, given in the Q1 2024 letter (May 2024) | $46.0B to $48.0B, so a **$47.0B midpoint** |
| Q3 2024 actual, from the Q3 2024 letter (Nov 2024) | **$43.5B** (up 56% year over year) |
| Shortfall | $3.5B, or ($43.5 − $47.0) / $47.0 ≈ **−7.4%** |

Q3 2024 volume came in below even the low end of the range, by about 5.4% against $46.0B.

The Q1 guidance table still has drafting notes in it ("format fix + change to #s from Nancy"), but the guidance numbers can be read clearly. I didn't check whether the Q2 2024 letter changed the Q3 guidance. This comparison uses only the guidance from Q1, as you asked.

**Sources**
- Form 8-K, EX-99.1 (Q1 2024 shareholder letter), filed 2024-05-09, accession 0001794669-24-000014
- Form 8-K, EX-99.1 (Q3 2024 shareholder letter), filed 2024-11-12, accession 0001794669-24-000031
